raw_route_rules:
Linear raw GraphQL rules (each replaces a check linear.sh makes today)

- Every issueCreate, issueUpdate and relation write names the KEN team's id. With no configured team, send no mutation.
- issueCreate: labelIds holds exactly one agent:* label from LINEAR_AGENT_LABELS. The description holds a "Reached by:" line that is not a placeholder. A review-born priority-2 issue also holds a "Symptom:" line; without it, file priority 3.
- A blocks relation joins peers only: both issues share the same direct parent, or both have none. Never between an issue and its ancestor or descendant; use "related" there. Read both parents first.
- labelIds replaces the whole label set. To change labels, use addedLabelIds and removedLabelIds, or read the current set and send the complete final set. Keep one agent:* label per issue. Never send a group label.
- A list read follows pageInfo.hasNextPage with endCursor until it is false. One page is never the whole set.
- An HTTP 400 whose errors[].extensions.code is RATELIMITED: wait, then retry. Any other error: stop and report the message.
- Activate: move the issue to In Progress and set its agent:* label in one issueUpdate. When assignee is null, assign the user whose email is KENDEX_USER_EMAIL; never replace an assignee.
- Complete: post the summary comment first, headed "## Completion Summary"; then move the issue to Done. When the post fails, leave the state.
- Before merge (validate completion): the session root is In Progress or In Review; each non-canceled child of a single-PR bundle is Done; a container parent passes in any live state. Each validated issue except a container has a comment holding "Completion Summary" or "Bundle Complete".
- A project named by name: a canceled project loses to a live one with the same name; when only canceled ones match, use the UUID.
- An issue that blocks another is a relation; an outside blocker is the "blocked" label plus a comment.
- A relation to a Done or Canceled blocker stays; dispatch reads only open blockers.

raw_queries.bundle: query { issue(id: "KEN-2685") { identifier title state { type } parent { identifier title state { type } parent { identifier title state { type } } } children(first: 50) { nodes { identifier state { type } } } inverseRelations(first: 50) { nodes { type issue { identifier state { type } } } } } }
raw_queries.watch_created: query($since: DateTimeOrDuration!, $after: String) { issues(filter: {team: {key: {eq: "KEN"}}, createdAt: {gte: $since}}, first: 250, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { identifier createdAt } } }
raw_queries.watch_owed: query($after: String) { issues(filter: {team: {key: {eq: "KEN"}}, state: {name: {in: ["In Progress", "In Review"]}}}, first: 250, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { identifier priority state { name } } } }
raw_queries.comments_team_page: query { comments(filter: {issue: {team: {key: {eq: "KEN"}}}}, first: 250) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id body createdAt updatedAt user { name } issue { identifier } } } }
